sections.title: Section 137 - Collection of Tax from Members of Stock Exchange The Chief Executive Officer of the Stock Exchange shall collect tax at the rate of 0.05
sections.content_text: Section 137 - Collection of Tax from Members of Stock Exchange The Chief Executive Officer of the Stock Exchange shall collect tax at the rate of 0.05% (point zero five percent) at the time payment of transaction value of shares, debentures, mutual funds or securities paid by the member of the Stock Exchange: Provided that the provisions of this section shall not apply to the transfer of any listed sukuk and bond.
